description: This file defines enums and structures related to representing and managing icon states within a macOS application, including roles, tools, activities, icon states, and override options with associated properties and mappings.

methods.name: badgeSymbolName
methods.description: Returns the symbol name for the badge based on the activity state.

methods.name: badgeProminence
methods.description: Returns the prominence level of the badge if applicable.

methods.name: isWorking
methods.description: Indicates whether the icon state is actively working.

methods.name: toIconState
methods.description: Converts an override selection to a corresponding icon state.
